name: preview-auto-recovery
goal: One managed preview automatically recovers its own failed or unresponsive worker at the same URL while preserving cached history.

evidence: A long-lived supervisor must recover a killed or unresponsive Vite worker at the same owned URL; duplicate starts still reuse it, shutdown must stay stopped, and cached history is preserved.

The existing preview lifecycle crash case kills the entire launch group and manually starts another preview. It does not cover autonomous worker recovery, event-loop hangs, repeated server errors or intentional shutdown after recovery. Extend that same reusable fixture and registered route-runtime state.
All three autonomous recovery cases fail on 897b840f; formal red f8ed6458 preserves the unchanged fixture, command and environment.
Fix 6a0c5def retains the ownership listener in Bun and supervises one Node worker with authenticated health probes, serialized shutdown and bounded recovery backoff.
Formal green 3c0af98a at 6a0c5def passes the exact frozen command from red c533e8c6 at e2a95036. All eleven lifecycle cases also pass.
